changes: Every language is now fully translated, including texts that were still shown in English in several languages.
Fixed corrupted Finnish texts on the nozzle prompt, the station setup steps and the station status.
Routine fuel console messages no longer clutter your server console, warnings and errors are still always shown.
Update lyre_bridge to 2.4.0 or newer so routine console logs are hidden by default and can be turned on per script in the lyre_bridge config.lua.
Running the setfuel or station management command from the server console now shows a clear warning that it can only be used in-game.
!! IMPORTANT !! UPDATE lyre_bridge TO 2.3.0 OR NEWER BEFORE INSTALLING THIS VERSION.
The HUD show and hide hooks and the menu background blur are now set once in the lyre_bridge config.lua for every Lyre script.
Values you still set in this script's config.lua keep priority, so your current setup keeps working.
The menu background blur can be turned on or off again (off by default).
Fixes the stations admin command refusing admins whose rank comes from the framework (ESX group or QBCore permission) instead of an ACE permission.
!! IMPORTANT !! SQL MIGRATION REQUIRED. Re-run import.sql to add the vehicle inspection history table.
Update lyre_bridge to 2.2.0 alongside this release.
Adds a vehicle inspector menu and a fuel_inspector item that lets mechanics scan a vehicle and review its filter, injectors, octane and LPG state.
Adds a testable LPG conversion setup with installable tank, vaporizer, filter and injectors.
Restores the diesel exhaust smoke effect that was broken in the previous build, plus many UX and stability fixes across maintenance prompts, refuel menu, octane mixing, and station persistence.
Make sure to update lyre_bridge alongside this resource. The previous release was broken.
New Lyre Scripts structure: install and start lyre_bridge before this resource.
lyre_bridge is open source and is not included in Granted Assets ZIPs; download it here: https://github.com/lyrescripts/lyre_bridge
Fuel bridge integrations and usable item registration now go through lyre_bridge.
Release package cleaned and simplified; compare your old config with the new config before updating.
